a.text: I'll stick to our agreement and operate in round 1. Storms are very likely (80% each round), so the plan is risky for both of us. Still, I won't take anything early. Operate with me so we reach 8 as fast as we can, then we take 4 each.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating. Two rounds of operating together should get us to 8, barring leaks. Then we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. If the reserve hits 8, I'll take exactly 4 next round, as agreed.

b.text: If the reserve reaches 8, I will take my 4 next round.
